# `location`

Core object · HSDS v3.2.3 · tabular file `locations.csv` · [online reference](https://docs.openreferral.org/en/latest/hsds/schema_reference.html#location)

> The locations where organizations operate. Locations may be virtual, and one organization may have many locations.

**Required:** `id`, `location_type`
